admission_type_official_wording: Subject to entry requirements; procedure for assessing the required requirements

admission_routes.notes: ESSE3 Eligibility Check followed by enrolment after a positive outcome.
Standard eligibility-check route, subject to legal-equivalence classification.
Use the 2026/27 international pre-admission call, then complete Universitaly and visa procedures.

academic_requirements.summary: Either a degree in class 9/26 (DM 509/99) or L-8/L-31 (DM 270/04), or another bachelor's/equivalent with at least 60 CFU across INF/01, ING-INF/*, MAT/*, BIO/*, CHIM/* or MED/*, including at least 12 CFU in INF/01 or ING-INF/* (alternatively 12 CFU in BIO/*, CHIM/* or MED/* plus documented computational training) and at least 6 CFU in MAT/*. Additional personal-preparation assessment applies to listed-class graduates below 88/110, degrees older than ten years, and all other-class graduates. The international pre-admission route requires a foreign bachelor's in Computer Science or related, Bioinformatics, or a field with strong Computer Science training, with CGPA at least 80/100.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: Suitable equivalent; international-call formulation: bachelor's in Computer Science or related, Bioinformatics, or another area requiring strong basic Computer Science training.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.subject_area_or_ssd: INF/01, ING-INF/*, MAT/*, BIO/*, CHIM/*, MED/* combined
minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: Alternative route for applicants outside the listed degree classes.
May be replaced by 12 CFU in BIO/*, CHIM/* or MED/* with documented computational training.

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: Standard route: further assessment below 88/110 for listed classes. International pre-admission route: CGPA or equivalent at least 80/100.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: Curriculum and marks are assessed; an interview may follow. All applicants from non-listed degree classes receive additional preparation assessment.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: Ordinary admission is not described as quota-based. International-call scholarship/benefit eligibility requires at least 60/100.

selection_components.weight_or_threshold: Mandatory requirements; additional assessment under published cases
selection_components.notes: May be followed by an interview.

selection_components.component: International-call academic curriculum, institution ranking, English above B2, and relevance
Up to two recommendation letters and one motivation letter

selection_components.weight_or_threshold: 0-20 points; held only at 50 points from criteria 1-3

language_requirements.summary: English at CEFR B2 is required.
accepted_language_certificates: Valid B2-equivalent certification listed by UNIVR CLA
Other complete B2 certification/documentation accepted by the assessment commission
certificate_exemptions: Degree certificate records a complete English B2 examination
For international pre-admission, previous degree taught in English
language_requirements.notes: Duolingo is accepted under the international call only for candidates from Iran or Afghanistan.

application_windows.applicant_category: Foreign-degree non-Italian applicants not resident in Italy

required_documents.document: Requirements Assessment Request Form and supporting academic records
required_documents.condition: Upload through the ESSE3 eligibility-check procedure.

required_documents.document: Identity document or passport personal-data pages
Bachelor's diploma or enrolment certificate with expected graduation date
required_documents.condition: International-call candidates awaiting graduation must graduate by 30 June 2026.

required_documents.document: English transcript of records or Diploma Supplement
required_documents.condition: Include exams and preferably ECTS, weighted average, and grading range.

required_documents.document: CV in English, maximum two pages
Up to two recommendation letters and one motivation letter

document_legalisation_translation_rules: Pre-admitted candidates must provide the official translation and legalisation of the bachelor's diploma and a Declaration of Value from the competent Italian diplomatic office.

entry_exam_or_test.name: Personal-preparation interview
entry_exam_or_test.mode: Interview if needed; online interview under international-call selection
entry_exam_or_test.minimum_score: International call: 60/100 overall; interview only at 50 points across criteria 1-3.
entry_exam_or_test.notes: No TOLC/SAT-style admission test is specified. The ordinary assessment starts with curriculum analysis.

application_fee.notes: International pre-admission contribution; deducted from contributions after enrolment except for scholarship winners.

tuition_amount_basis: First instalment EUR 358; second and third instalments are variable and calculated under the 2026/27 university contribution and ISEEU/ISEE-equivalent rules.
